en: Everyone knows Atlantis, but almost no one knows where the story actually comes from.
There is no ancient map, no ruins, no inscription.
The entire legend comes from one man, Plato.
Around 360 BC, he wrote it into two dialogues, the Timaeus and the
And the story he tells is a chain of whispers.
An Egyptian priest told it to the Athenian statesman Solon.
Solon passed it on, and it was handed down, generation after generation, until
The priest spoke of a mighty naval empire beyond the Pillars of Hercules, an
empire that tried to conquer the Mediterranean.
Then, in a single day and night, earthquakes and floods swallowed it into the
9,000 years before Plato, yet no writer before him ever mentions it.
Many historians believe Plato invented it as a warning about arrogant empires.
So, was Atlantis real or the greatest story ever told?
